description: RISC-V RV32 scalar subset with +m,+zmmul,+zbb: the product of the XLen and feature axes. Custom: 32-bit abs, clz/ctz (shadowed by legalFor on RV32), 32-bit div/rem (also shadowed), and the 64-bit counters. Libcall: 64-bit div/rem. Lower: carry/saturating/overflow, no-P/no-Zbkb/no-Zbkc leftovers, abs family, min/max, compare, divrem, and the poison count-zeros.
